meta.name: design-taste-frontend-v1
meta.description: The original v1 taste-skill, preserved for projects depending on its exact behavior. The current default is `design-taste-frontend` (v2 experimental), which is a substantial rewrite. Use this v1 install name only if you need exact backward compatibility.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 保留旧版设计品味，确保前端项目兼容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果项目依赖旧版设计品味技能的行为
copy.tagline_en: Preserve legacy design taste for frontend compatibility
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your project depends on the exact behavior of the v1 design taste skill

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照一套严格的设计规则生成前端代码，包括排版、颜色、布局、动效等，并自动检查依赖、禁止使用 emoji，确保输出高质量、非模板化的界面。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 生成前端代码（如 React/Next.js 组件、页面布局）时触发。

say.text: 帮我做一个产品展示页，用 split-screen 布局。
say.note: Claude 会按照设计规则生成不对称的左右分屏页面。

say.text: 生成一个仪表盘，视觉密度设为 8。
say.note: Claude 会使用紧凑布局、等宽字体，避免卡片容器。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates frontend code following strict design rules for typography, color, layout, motion, etc., automatically checks dependencies, bans emojis, and ensures high-quality, non-generic interfaces.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to generate frontend code (e.g., React/Next.js components, page layouts).

say_en.text: Create a product showcase page with a split-screen layout.
say_en.note: Claude will generate an asymmetric left-right split page per design rules.

say_en.text: Generate a dashboard with visual density set to 8.
say_en.note: Claude will use compact layout, monospace font, and avoid card containers.
